I am repeating the systems commands course, I am getting the following error, can someone help me understand the error and help me resolve this?

posts.name: S.Vignesh
posts.cooked: Try the command ssh-keygen -t rsa to generate rsa keys. Then copy the rsa public key and paste it into the systems command vm registration web page.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
This is part of Week 2 Kabir.

You get REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED! when the remote’s identity is different from the one you have stored in your .ssh/known_hosts file.

Recall the solution discussed in Week 2, run ssh-keygen -R se2001.ds.study.iitm.ac.in to remove the identity from the known hosts file and try to ssh again.

You do not need to regenerate keys.

posts.name: Kabir Vyas
posts.cooked: Thanks for this, updated the known_hosts file and its working now!
